blackoutRules.coveredWindow: A covered employee with material access may not trade from 14 calendar days before through 2 calendar days after a material issuer event.
blackoutRules.scheduledPlanExemption: A fixed, pre-cleared scheduled plan established before the window is exempt.
blackoutRules.sectorContext: A sector-wide move without issuer-specific access is not by itself an issuer blackout breach.
